description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEmergencyContactsController class within the OrangeHRM application. The class manages the rendering of employee emergency contact information, sets component properties, and handles permissions based on HTTP request attributes.

classes.name: EmployeeEmergencyContactsController
classes.description: Controller class handling the display and permissions setup for employee emergency contacts within the HRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component to display emergency contacts for a specific employee, setting permissions if 'empNumber' is present in the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data group identifiers used for capability checks related to emergency contacts.
